fz-two-edits.why: pdfEcho lays out one change from PE.changed's common prefix/suffix: an unbuilt edit in an earlier paragraph plus typing in the next spans the paragraph break; the echo needs per-paragraph change spans (build offsets mapped through each edit)

fz-ts-end-keeps-typed.owner: ui-51 (playground Type mode); fuzz/run.mjs --replay with the scenario's seq reproduces it
fz-ts-end-keeps-typed.why: End (caretLine in the Typeset view) redraws the pending typed row from a text that lacks the second word typed: arrows must never change what is shown (timing dependent: failed 1 of 2 runs, keep until --repeat 3 passes)

fz-ts-footnote-row.owner: ui-51 (playground Type mode); fuzz/run.mjs --replay with the scenario's seq reproduces it
fz-ts-footnote-row.why: typing in a footnote's text in the Typeset view adds a second footnote row (tsParaDraw: the footnote is no paragraph of its own) and leaves the caret on another row; another run: caret 7 px left of the typed word's end (caret-glyph)

fz-pdf-caret-after-end.owner: ui-51 (playground Type mode); fuzz/run.mjs --replay with the scenario's seq reproduces it
fz-pdf-caret-after-end.why: after End and a landed build, typing in the footnote draws the caret 7 px right of the typed word's last glyph

fz-ts-land-jump.owner: ui-51 (playground Type mode); fuzz/run.mjs --replay with the scenario's seq reproduces it
fz-ts-land-jump.why: two-column Typeset view: the caret jumps ~400 px when the typeset of two typed words lands; another run: ArrowUp changed the pending row's text (`is xqrakoc.` -> `is short. xqrakoc`), an arrow must never change what is shown
